title: Online gambling and betting apps - legality across Indian states
p1: A betting app can be legal in one Indian state and restricted in another. Surprising, right? Many people assume that if an app is available online, it must be legal everywhere in India.
p2: The reality is more complicated. Gambling laws in India are largely governed by state regulations, and different states take different approaches. Another lesser-known point: games based mainly on skill, such as some fantasy sports formats, are often treated differently from games based mainly on chance.
p3: This means the legality of an online gambling or betting platform depends on factors like the state you are in, the type of game, and the latest local rules. A simple app download does not automatically mean a legal green signal. Always check the rules applicable in your state before participating.
conclusion: Do you think online betting apps should follow one uniform law across India, or should each state continue making its own rules?
